LESSON: PAINTING AND COLLAGE

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Creating and Executing
Topic 1.2: Painting and Collage
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 15

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Painting and Collage, part of Creating and Executing in Grade 6 CREATIVE ARTS.

Key inquiry question: Why is mounting of pictures important?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. mix and paint a colour wheel to represent primary, secondary and tertiary colours,

2. mix and paint a surface to create tonal gradation by; thinning same tone/adding dark tone,

3. illustrate painting to create varied texture focusing on; brush position/angle, brush load and brush strokes,

4. paint any two objects overlapping inspired by football game, (tone and texture,

5. source for mounting materials and tools (papers, glue, cutting tools),

6. prepare the picture and mat surface by; measuring and cutting,

7. attach the picture on the mat surface (centred position), 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. mix and paint a colour wheel to represent primary, secondary and tertiary colours,
2. mix and paint a surface to create tonal gradation by; thinning same tone/adding dark tone,
3. illustrate painting to create varied texture focusing on; brush position/angle, brush load and brush strokes,
4. paint any two objects overlapping inspired by football game, (tone and texture,
5. source for mounting materials and tools (papers, glue, cutting tools),
6. prepare the picture and mat surface by; measuring and cutting,
7. attach the picture on the mat surface (centred position), 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Painting and Collage together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking and problem solving: The learner explores multiple perspectives of painting using varied tools and

materials for creativity.

• Creativity and imagination: The learner applies creative skills in selecting media for painting, and painting the still life

composition.

Values:
• Responsibility: The learner works on art work and cleans up after the activities.

• Unity: The learner collaboratively, make a collage with a theme ‘football’ to apply the characteristics.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Waste management: The learner disposes of the waste after the classroom activity.

• Social cohesion: The learner works in a group to watch actual or virtual paintings and discuss.

Link to other learning areas:

Mathematics: Learner prepares the picture and mat surface by measuring and cutting.
